title: Precrna Rupa
description: Precrna Rupa is a satirical narrative adventure/puzzle game set in Zagreb, where players find themselves trapped in an area below Sljeme. The game is meant to be played alongside its official manual (available at https://mayazmaya.itch.io/precrna-rupa), which is required to solve puzzles based on the album POYY by artist IDEM and to decode a hidden alphabet scattered throughout the game. The experience also includes an in-game karaoke feature. The game is available in English and Croatian.
